name: Cable Reverse Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench facing a low pulley, rest your forearms on your thighs, and grip the bar palms down past your knees.
Lift your knuckles by extending your wrists upward.
Lower the bar slowly below the line of your forearms.
tips: Keep your elbows and forearms resting flat on your thighs.
Use a controlled range of motion without jerking your arms upward.
